Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding car-sharing activities from the rental car tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excluding carsharing activities from the rentalcar tax; amending RCW 82.08.011; creating a new section; providing aneffective date; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that car sharingdiffers from traditional car rental in important ways that benefit thestate; that while offering a practical alternative to car ownership,car sharing reduces vehicle ownership, reduces vehicle miles traveled,and increases the use of public transit. The collective impacttranslates to reduced congestion on roads and reduced greenhouse gasforming carbon emissions in the air. The legislature intends, throughthis legislation, to continue to support carsharing activities byexempting such limited activities from the rental car tax.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.08.011 and 1992 c 194 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section,for purposes of this chapter, "retail car rental" means renting arental car, as defined in RCW 46.04.465, to a consumer. p. 1 SHB 2880 (2) For the purposes of this section, "retail car rental" does notinclude car sharing as defined in RCW 82.70.010 where: (a) Passengervehicles are provided to members of an organization; (b) theorganization charges a membership fee separate from the charge for theuse of a specific vehicle; (c) the average of all paid usage periodsduring the previous calendar year was less than eight hours; (d)vehicles are available to members in parking spaces at dispersedlocations or facilities, which locations or facilities are not owned orcontrolled by the carsharing business; and in the previous calendaryear, not more than fifty percent of the locations or facilities hadmore than four vehicles available to members at any one time; and (e)no separate written agreement is required each time a member reservesand uses a vehicle.
